title.zh: 将卡皮斯省罗哈斯总统市镇蒂嫩丹小学的名称变更为Elizalde纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Tinundan Elementary School in the Municipality of President Roxas, Province of Capiz, to Elizalde Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Tinundan Elementary School in the Municipality of President Roxas, Province of Capiz, to Elizalde Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Tinundan tại Thị trấn President Roxas, Tỉnh Capiz thành Trường tiểu học Elizalde Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tinundan ในเทศบาล President Roxas, จังหวัด Capiz เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Elizalde Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Tinundan di Kotamadya President Roxas, Provinsi Capiz menjadi Sekolah Dasar Elizalde Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Tinundan di Perbandaran President Roxas, Wilayah Capiz menjadi Sekolah Rendah Elizalde Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3921_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Tinundan Elementary School in the Municipality of President Roxas, Province of Capiz, is hereby changed to Elizalde Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
